title: RS Automart
content: Built RS Automart as a full-stack automotive e-commerce platform — developing the React frontend, backend APIs, and database layer end to end. Implemented product catalog management, advanced search & filtering, shopping cart, and a streamlined checkout flow, with a focus on speed, accessibility, and conversion.
